scope: All unique authoritative Hero Deck Cards; classification/checklist only, never full-effect certification.
methodology: Automatic mechanic tags are fixture-planning hints, not semantic validation; the complete verbatim printed rule remains authoritative.
A source reference only identifies a relevant test file. It does not mean its assertions cover the card or that the test passed.
The 9 exact simple-Attack rows measure damage, cost and discard only.
The generic dispatcher sweep asserts inventory counts/unique IDs; reactions are not dispatched, exceptions are recorded and no-ops have no effect oracle.

Every card requires review of every printed clause/conditional/duration, an independent expected outcome, negative/cancel behavior, and relevant canonical connected-state checks before full certification.
New shared-mechanic tests can verify a family once, but every card still needs its own mapping/target/cost/branch contract.
